name: Order Tip/Donation for WooCommerce
author: PI Websolution

sections.description:
Order Tip/Donation for WooCommerce empowers store owners to collect tips or donations directly from customers during the checkout process. It provides customizable tip/donation options and is ideal for businesses looking to offer gratuity options or support charitable causes.

Key Features:

  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce checkout.
  • Option to allow fixed or custom tip/donation amounts.
  • Predefined tip percentage options (e.g., 5%, 10%, 15%, $20, $50).
  • Customizable labels for the tip/donation field.
  • Custom tip/donation amount option for customers.
  • Display tips/donations as a line item in the order summary.
  • Supports both tips for services and donations for charitable causes.
  • Make donation is required field, so customer cant checkout without paying tip or donation
  • Adjust the position of the tip/donation field on the checkout page.
  • You can set the color of the tip button and donation button
  • Show tip / donation option, based on the user role

Use Cases:

  • Restaurants, coffee shops, and other service-based businesses collecting gratuity.
  • Non-profits and charity organizations accepting donations.
  • E-commerce stores encouraging support for specific causes.
  • Don’t show tip option to wholesale customer (based on the user role)

How It Works:

Once installed and activated, configure the plugin from the WooCommerce settings to enable tip/donation collection. Add predefined tip percentages or allow customers to enter a custom amount. Custom labels make it easy to align with your branding.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the downloaded zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Tips/Donations to configure options.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the label for tips/donations?

Yes, you can set a custom label for both tips and donations in the plugin settings.
